product_one_liner.value: CloudTalk provides an AI-powered business phone system and AI voice-agent platform for sales and support teams.
product_one_liner.notes: Company’s own company overview states its product and intended users.

named_customers.notes: All are named on CloudTalk customer-story pages.

employee_band.notes: CloudTalk’s LinkedIn company profile gives company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company states it was founded in Bratislava; although some LinkedIn-sourced listings show Toronto as headquarters, CloudTalk’s own story identifies its home city as Bratislava.

founded_year.notes: CloudTalk says it was founded in 2016.

eng_blog.notes: At least two developer-blog articles cover engineering reliability/testing and the engineering/product development process.

public_docs.notes: Public help center and developer documentation contain multiple articles and API resources.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Open roles were surfaced, but none of the listed titles meets the specified AI/ML/data-science role-title criteria; ‘AI-Enabled’ appears in a product-education title and does not qualify.

model_provider.value: OpenAI (the public VoiceAgent Expert Mode documentation names OpenAI models, including GPT-4o Mini and GPT-4o).
model_provider.notes: CloudTalk’s product documentation lists OpenAI model options; its subprocessor page also names OpenAI.

compliance_certs.notes: CloudTalk publicly claims SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 compliance. GDPR is also discussed as compliance, but is not a certification in the sense asked.

last_funding.notes: The publicly announced Series B was $28 million and dated January 17, 2024.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent funding round located was January 2024, before the 18-month lookback window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Workable lists a Sales Development Representative (SDR) opening.

launched_6mo.notes: CloudTalk announced the AI Sales Dialer launch within the six-month window; its help center states the new version became available September 28, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No verifiable dated source established that a C-level or VP-level leader joined or departed during 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09. The accessible career page team content does not establish start dates or departures.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public integrations guide names these CRM systems and related sales systems.
